purpose: Test whether the descriptive D2 size and sector attrition patterns remain visible after accounting for unequal follow-up and administrative right censoring.
accessOrder: freeze this preregistration and its bound D1/D2 inputs
run the fixture-only self-test and deliberate sabotage
verify the committed D1 and D2 aggregate anchors byte-for-byte
reproduce the D1 population/outcomes and D2 groups exactly
compute identity-free Kaplan-Meier summaries within the frozen groups
render the report only from that JSON artifact
forbiddenInputPolicy: Every other panel basename, encrypted file, or row with accepted date after 2020-12-31 aborts before aggregation.

population.sizeGroups: unchanged from D2: entry AFS 1-LAF/2-ACC versus 3-SRA/4-NON/5-SML; missing or unknown remains separate
population.sectorGroups: unchanged from D2: SIC division at the entry filing; unclassified remains separate
population.identityPolicy: CIKs may exist only in process memory. No company identifier or company name may be written to an artifact or report.

timeDefinition.axis: integer calendar quarters since D1 entry
timeDefinition.rightCensoring: the exact D1 administrative censoring at 2020-12-31
timeDefinition.eventCensorOrder: events are applied before censoring at the same integer duration

primaryTest.statistic: Kaplan-Meier survival at 12 quarters for smaller minus larger, in percentage points
primaryTest.nullModel: the two entry-AFS size groups have equal 12-quarter evaluability survival
primaryTest.threshold: absolute difference of at least 5.0 percentage points, carried forward from D2 before panel access
primaryTest.directionCheck: D2 and D4 are directionally consistent only when a positive D2 smaller-minus-larger attrition difference corresponds to a negative D4 smaller-minus-larger survival difference

sectorSensitivity.statistic: maximum minus minimum 12-quarter Kaplan-Meier survival among D2 sectors with at least 200 companies and an estimable horizon
sectorSensitivity.nullModel: all eligible entry-sector groups have equal 12-quarter evaluability survival
sectorSensitivity.threshold: a range of at least 10.0 percentage points is flagged descriptively

secondaryOutputs: full Kaplan-Meier curve and median stay for each size group
full Kaplan-Meier curve and median stay for each entry-sector group
company, event, censoring, and at-risk counts for every group
explicit non-estimability if a group has no observation at the common horizon
effectiveN: unique company within each stratum; strata are compared but never pooled as independent repeated observations; filings and days add no observations
requiredInvariants: D1 company, event, censoring, and cadence totals reproduce exactly
D2 size and sector company, event, and censoring totals reproduce exactly
every group reconciles events plus censoring to companies
every Kaplan-Meier curve is monotone and within [0,1]
the primary contrast is recomputable from the two group survival probabilities
the output contains no company identifiers, company names, signal fields, daily observations, or post-2020 dates
explicitNonClaims: This sensitivity analysis does not replace or rewrite D2.
Kaplan-Meier adjustment does not prove non-informative censoring.
AFS remains a regulatory size proxy, not market capitalization or accounting size.
Associations are not causal and do not identify why a company disappears.
No threshold here is a study, method, or product gate.
